sheets.weapons: HIS HANDS AND GUNS go where the pale figure has them, frame by frame (image 3 shows them in colour): the gold-armoured arm with the cane gun (its teal-wrapped shaft), Whisper (ivory stock, dark grey barrel, gold fittings), the grenade in the gold fist, and in his R the great gun on his shoulder - each as long as in image 1 (R's great gun as in the pale figure), raised, aimed, twirled or thrown as the pale figure holds it. The pale figures of his attack, fourth shot, Q, W and R shot are the old frames' bodies without their muzzle flashes: do NOT draw the flashes. Only him: no petals, no smoke, no bullets; the eyes' pink stays on the mask.
